title: DiffCI change plan (diffci.gate-plan.v1)
description: DiffCI's decisions for one commit range: which gate checks run, are narrowed or are skipped, and which tests are selected, each with a reason. Written by `diffci gate --plan-out`; read by `diffci gate --plan`. See docs/change-plan.md.

diffci_version.description: Version of the DiffCI package that wrote the plan.

range.description: The commits the plan is for. Absent when no range could be resolved; every check then runs as written.

head_sha.description: A consumer must not use a plan whose head_sha is not the commit being gated.

source.description: How the range was chosen: explicit-flags, pull-request-event, push-event or head-parent.

status.description: OBSERVED when the change was analysed; REFUSED or ERROR otherwise, in which case tests.selection is unavailable.

reason.description: Why the change was not analysed.

mode.description: FULL when the analysis fell back to the whole suite.

fallback_reasons.description: Why the analysis fell back to the full suite; empty when it did not.

checks.description: Every leaf of the repository's gate (for example `npm run check`), in the order the gate runs them.

id.description: The script name, or `script[n]` for the n-th part of one.

decision.description: RUN as written, NARROWED to the changed files (command rewritten), or SKIP for this change.

command.description: The command to run; for NARROWED, the narrowed command.

selection.description: unavailable means the consumer must run its full test command.

selected_commands.description: Present only when selection is selected: the commands that run the selected tests, in order.
